ground_truth.unit: change in the cabinet replacement rate (share of ministers, 0-1)
ground_truth.location: Table A1 (Tables for Figure 2), column Base Model, Failed coup attempt
ground_truth.context: Table A1 ("Failed coup attempts. Country fixed effects: Country-level results"), Base Model column; plotted in the left panel of Figure 2. Time-series cross-sectional OLS of the year-to-year cabinet replacement rate (one minus the cabinet-size-adjusted retention rate of ministers, from WhoGov, July to July) on a failed coup attempt indicator (Powell and Thyne data; a failed coup before 1 July counts in that year, one after 1 July in the following year), with logged GDP per capita and logged population (Penn World Table 9.0) lagged one year, country fixed effects and year fixed effects.  Sample: country-years of independent countries with a lagged Boix-Miller- Rosato democracy score of 0, 115 autocracies, 1967-2016.  Standard errors clustered by country.

i4r.notes: Blanket verdict (perfect reproduction).  R re-coding rows with o_coeff 0.10 (Table A1 Base or Purges MAs, which share the rounded value): 0.102 (0.031) and 0.129 (0.031).  Stata log: 0.0985 (0.0327).

ground_truth.unit: change in the probability of being purged next year
ground_truth.location: Table K1 (Table for Figure 3), column H2a: Experience, Failed coup attempt
ground_truth.context: Table K1, column H2a: Experience; Figure 3 left panel.  Linear probability model of whether a cabinet member is purged (absent from the cabinet the following year; reshuffles within the cabinet are not purges) on a failed coup attempt indicator, experience-group dummies (2-3, 4-6, over 6 years in cabinet; reference under 2 years), their interactions with the failed coup indicator, lagged logged GDP per capita and population, country and year fixed effects.  Minister-years in autocracies 1967-2016, excluding the leader and junior ministers or other low-ranking posts; standard errors clustered by country.  The failed coup coefficient is the effect for ministers with under two years of experience.

i4r.notes: Meta-database row 5633 (table k1 experience, felm to fixest) 0.142112 (0.043907); o_coeff 0.142112 (0.041926).

ground_truth.unit: difference in the change in purge probability
ground_truth.location: Table K1, column H2a: Experience, FCA*Over 6 years of experience (Ref: <2 y)
ground_truth.context: Table K1, column H2a: Experience: the interaction of the failed coup attempt indicator with having over six years of cabinet experience (reference: under two years), in the same linear probability model as failed_coup_experience_model.

i4r.notes: Derived from the fixest marginal effects: over-6-years 0.039173 (row 5665) minus under-2-years 0.142112 (row 5633).  The figure 3a logit row records the original interaction as -0.103 (0.052).

ground_truth.unit: change in the probability of being purged next year
ground_truth.location: Table K1, column H2b: Affiliation, Failed coup attempt
ground_truth.context: Table K1, column H2b: Affiliation; Figure 3 right panel.  Linear probability model of being purged next year on the failed coup attempt indicator, party affiliation dummies (no party affiliation; from the leader's party; reference: from another party than the leader's), their interactions with the failed coup indicator, cubic polynomials in the minister's years in office, lagged logged GDP per capita and population, country and year fixed effects, country-clustered standard errors.  The failed coup coefficient is the effect for ministers from another party than the leader's.

i4r.notes: Meta-database row 5640 (table k1 affiliation, felm to fixest) 0.174175 (0.056069); o_coeff 0.174175 (0.056053).
